trust_decision.summary: Whether an unauthenticated password-recovery request may spend paid AbstractAPI quota and DNS lookups on an arbitrary attacker-chosen email; decided in the form-request rules, which call PublicFormGuardService::mergeRules with advanced email validation on by default.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'password recovery endpoints'; the route file shows password.email and password.update with their throttle/recaptcha middleware, which is where one would first reach for a rate limit.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Livewire public forms using ValidatesPublicFormSubmissions are not password-recovery endpoints and have no in-tree user (app/Concerns/ValidatesPublicFormSubmissions.php:13), so a solver can call them a separate feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Registration must keep running the full three-tier email check (local + paid AbstractAPI). It has its own pre-validation per-IP limit. An over-broad fix that disables API verification globally or inside EmailSubmissionValidator breaks it.

O6_input_shapes: email field as a plain string (the validation closure ignores non-strings, app/Services/EmailSubmissionValidator.php:85)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Livewire public forms using ValidatesPublicFormSubmissions run advanced email validation (DNS + AbstractAPI) via emailsFailAdvancedValidation by default; no in-tree component uses the trait, so this is reachable only through modules.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not a password-recovery endpoint, no in-tree caller, and these forms are meant to filter spam emails.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An email-change / resend-verification form request with mergeRules(emailFields:['email']) left on advanced validation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CHANGELOG says the auth flows were migrated to Form Requests with the shared guard (CHANGELOG.md:51); a maintainer would reuse the same mergeRules call.

O9_family: CWE-770 resource exhaustion: unauthenticated consumption of paid third-party API quota and outbound DNS lookups

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Tighten the throttle:20,1 middleware on password.email/password.update instead of dropping advanced email validation from the two form requests.

out_of_scope_notes: The User::sendPasswordResetNotification admin branch depends on request()->is('admin/*'), but the admin password routes are just redirects (app/Models/User.php:129, app/Providers/AdminRoutingServiceProvider.php:42-45); not pursued.
